title: Capability Infrastructure: A National Workforce Intelligence System
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Capability Infrastructure: A National Workforce Intelligence System
detail.abstract:
Governments worldwide collect vast amounts of workforce data but continue to struggle to convert it into coordinated, actionable insight. Systems such as Singapore's SkillsFuture and Saudi Arabia's National Labor Observatory exemplify this paradox: despite technological sophistication, both face challenges in preventing persistent skills mismatches and responding effectively to AI-driven disruptions. Over the past decade, digital credentialing systems, skills observatories, and national qualification frameworks have proliferated across advanced and emerging economies. Yet these systems often remain siloed repositories of information rather than engines of coordination. They are designed for record-keeping and compliance, not for predictive intelligence or agile policymaking. Even in digitally mature countries such as Estonia or Singapore, interoperability between education, employment, and training datasets is incomplete, making it difficult to anticipate emerging skills needs or track transitions across occupations.

This research proposes capability infrastructure as a new class of socio-technical system that integrates data standards, credential ontologies, and governance frameworks to enable adaptive and trustworthy workforce intelligence. Unlike e-government systems that digitize existing processes, capability infrastructures create recursive feedback loops connecting education providers, employers, and policymakers through interoperable data standards and shared governance protocols. By embedding inclusion and interoperability as design principles, they transform fragmented databases into collective intelligence systems for the labor market.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"能力基础设施"作为新型社会技术系统，通过整合数据标准、证书本体和治理框架，解决全球劳动力数据系统碎片化问题，实现自适应、可信的劳动力智能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计能够有效整合碎片化劳动力数据、实现跨部门协调、并能适应AI驱动变革的社会技术系统？
AI.motivation: 全球政府收集了大量劳动力数据，但现有系统（如新加坡SkillsFuture、沙特国家劳动力观察站）仍面临技能不匹配、应对AI变革能力不足的问题。这些系统多为信息孤岛，缺乏预测智能和敏捷政策制定能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力基础设施理论、社会技术系统理论、互操作性理论、集体智能理论
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过分析现有劳动力数据系统的局限性，提出"能力基础设施"的理论框架和设计原则
AI.findings: 现有劳动力数据系统存在碎片化、互操作性不足、设计偏向记录保存而非预测智能等问题。能力基础设施通过数据标准、证书本体和治理框架的整合，能创建连接教育提供者、雇主和政策制定者的递归反馈循环。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"能力基础设施"作为新型社会技术系统的理论框架；发展了互操作性和包容性作为设计原则的理论基础；为劳动力智能系统研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府设计更有效的劳动力数据系统提供具体设计原则；提出通过互操作性数据标准和共享治理协议解决系统碎片化问题；为应对AI驱动的劳动力市场变革提供实用解决方案。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Training: Opportunities and Challenges in The Zimbabwean Mining Industry
affiliations: Zimbabwe Open University

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Training: Opportunities and Challenges in The Zimbabwean Mining Industry
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is Each and every aspect of our society has been changed by artificial intelligence. Artificial intelligence still a new phenomenon in Zimbabwe. The main thrust Each and every aspect of our society has been changed by artificial intelligence. Artificial intelligence is still a new phenomenon in Zimbabwe. The main thrust of this research was to understand the opportunities and challenges of artificial intelligence in training activities in the mining industry. This study was guided by understand training activities that can be transformed by artificial intelligence. The study determined the challenges of using artificial intelligence in training. The investigator obtained data through telephone interviews that were conducted with 10 participants from the Zimbabwe Mining Industry. The investigation employed judgemental, convenient and snowball sampling. The study found that there is low use of artificial intelligence in the training activities, but there are activities that can be undertaken by artificial intelligence that include induction, online training, and refresher courses. Expensiveness, lack of skills, loss of jobs, cultural and ethical implications were found to be challenges associated with the use of artificial intelligence in the employee appointment process. Efficiency, effectiveness, enhanced trainee experience, reduced costs and organisation brand were found to be benefits of employing artificial intelligence in training. The study recommends partnerships to be developed among mining organisations, higher and tertiary education, and technology enterprises to develop artificial intelligence software that can cost-effectively meet the needs of trainers.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了人工智能在津巴布韦矿业培训活动中的机遇与挑战，发现AI使用率低但潜力巨大，面临成本、技能、就业等挑战，建议多方合作开发适用AI解决方案。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在津巴布韦矿业培训活动中有哪些机遇和挑战？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在改变社会各个领域，但在津巴布韦仍属新现象，特别是在矿业培训中的应用情况尚不明确，需要了解其潜在机会和实际障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于技术采纳与组织变革理论，探讨新兴技术在传统行业中的实施障碍和效益评估框架。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，通过电话访谈收集数据，使用判断抽样、便利抽样和滚雪球抽样方法，访谈了10名津巴布韦矿业从业者。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) 人工智能在培训活动中的使用率较低；2) 适合AI的培训活动包括入职培训、在线培训和复习课程；3) 主要挑战：成本高、技能缺乏、就业流失、文化和伦理问题；4) 主要效益：效率提升、效果改善、学员体验增强、成本降低、组织品牌提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家传统行业的技术采纳理论提供了实证支持，揭示了在资源有限环境中AI实施的特殊挑战和机遇模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议矿业组织、高等教育机构和科技企业建立合作伙伴关系，共同开发成本效益高、符合培训需求的AI软件解决方案。

title: O-Ring Automation
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: O-Ring Automation
detail.abstract: We study automation when tasks are quality complements rather than separable. Production requires numerous tasks whose qualities multiply as in an O-ring technology. A worker allocates a fixed endowment of time across the tasks performed; machines can replace tasks with given quality, and time is allocated across the remaining manual tasks. This "focus" mechanism generates three results. First, task-by-task substitution logic is incomplete because automating one task changes the return to automating others. Second, automation decisions are discrete and can require bundled adoption even when automation quality improves smoothly. Third, labour income can rise under partial automation because automation scales the value of remaining bottleneck tasks. These results imply that widely-used exposure indices, which aggregate tasklevel automation risk using linear formulas, will overstate displacement when tasks are complements. The relevant object is not average task exposure but the structure of bottlenecks and how automation reshapes worker time around them. Journal of Economic Literature Classification Numbers: D24, J23, J24, O33.

AI.tldr: 研究任务质量互补（而非可分离）情况下的自动化问题。采用O环技术模型，工人时间有限，机器可替代特定质量的任务。研究发现：1）任务间替代逻辑不完整，自动化一个任务会影响其他任务的自动化收益；2）自动化决策是离散的，即使自动化质量平滑改进也可能需要捆绑采用；3）部分自动化可能提高劳动收入，因为自动化放大了剩余瓶颈任务的价值。现有基于线性公式的自动化风险暴露指数会高估替代效应。
AI.research_question: 当任务质量互补而非可分离时，自动化如何影响生产过程和劳动收入？任务间的互补性如何改变自动化决策的逻辑？
AI.motivation: 现有自动化研究通常假设任务可分离，但现实生产中许多任务质量相互补充（如O环技术）。这种互补性可能改变自动化的经济逻辑，影响自动化决策和劳动力市场结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: O环生产函数（任务质量相乘），时间分配理论，任务互补性框架，自动化决策的离散选择模型
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建包含任务质量互补的生产函数模型，分析工人时间分配和机器替代决策。使用数学推导和比较静态分析。
AI.findings: 1）任务间替代逻辑不完整：自动化一个任务会改变其他任务的自动化收益；2）自动化决策离散性：即使自动化质量平滑改进，也可能需要捆绑采用；3）部分自动化可能提高劳动收入：自动化放大了剩余瓶颈任务的价值；4）现有自动化风险暴露指数会高估替代效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了任务互补性下的自动化理论；2）揭示了任务间自动化决策的相互依赖性；3）提出了"聚焦机制"概念；4）挑战了线性自动化风险暴露指数的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为企业和政策制定者提供更准确的自动化风险评估框架；2）指出部分自动化可能有利于工人收入；3）强调应关注瓶颈任务结构而非平均自动化风险。

title: Project Silicon Genesis: The Complete Story. From Quantum Mechanics to Modern Semiconductor Supremacy

detail.title: Project Silicon Genesis: The Complete Story. From Quantum Mechanics to Modern Semiconductor Supremacy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial, personal, or professional conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper. This study was conducted independently and without external commercial, governmental, or institutional bias. All interpretations and findings reflect the author’s scholarly judgment and commitment to academic integrity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or personally identifiable data, and therefore did not require formal ethics committee approval. The research is based entirely on published scientific literature, industry data, and publicly available technical references.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was self-funded by the author, Aldrich Khaalis Wooden, Sr., in his capacity as an independent researcher and Director of Enterprise Capture & Compliance at Visionblox Corporation.

detail.abstract: This comprehensive analysis traces the complete evolution of silicon semiconductor technology from fundamental quantum mechanical principles to modern nanoscale integrated circuits. We examine silicon's ascendance from obscure metalloid to the backbone of global computing infrastructure, analyzing the interplay between quantum mechanics, materials science, manufacturing innovation, and geopolitical forces. Through detailed technical analysis and data visualization, we explore the Czochralski crystal growth process, photolithographic scaling limits, Moore's Law progression, and emerging challenges at sub-3nm nodes where quantum tunneling and atomic-scale defects become dominant. We project future trajectories including gateall-around (GAA) transistors, extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography advancement to high-NA systems, alternative channel materials, and potential paradigm shifts toward quantum computing, neuromorphic architectures, and photonic integration. This work synthesizes physics, engineering, economics, and strategy to provide an authoritative account of semiconductors' past, present, and future, with implications extending from national security to technological sovereignty and the fundamental limits of computation itself.

AI.tldr: 本文全面追溯了硅半导体技术从量子力学原理到现代纳米级集成电路的完整演化历程，分析了硅如何从不起眼的类金属成为全球计算基础设施的支柱，探讨了量子力学、材料科学、制造创新和地缘政治力量之间的相互作用，并预测了未来技术发展方向。
AI.research_question: 硅半导体技术如何从量子力学基础原理演化到现代纳米级集成电路？这一演化过程中各种因素（物理、工程、经济、地缘政治）如何相互作用？未来技术发展的轨迹和挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 半导体技术是现代科技和经济的基石，理解其完整演化历程对于把握技术发展趋势、制定产业政策和应对未来挑战至关重要。当前半导体技术面临纳米尺度下的物理极限挑战，需要系统性分析其发展规律和未来方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子力学原理、材料科学理论、摩尔定律、技术演化理论、创新扩散理论、技术经济范式理论
AI.method: 综合技术分析、数据可视化、历史演化分析、多学科交叉分析（物理、工程、经济、战略）、技术预测方法
AI.findings: 硅半导体技术经历了从量子力学基础到现代集成电路的完整演化；技术发展受到物理极限、制造创新和经济因素的多重驱动；当前面临3纳米以下节点的量子隧穿和原子级缺陷等根本性挑战；未来技术发展将围绕GAA晶体管、高数值孔径EUV光刻、替代沟道材料等方向展开。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了半导体技术演化的多因素交互框架；建立了从量子力学基础到产业应用的全链条分析模型；发展了技术极限预测的理论方法；为理解技术演化中的物理-工程-经济-地缘政治相互作用提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为半导体产业技术路线图制定提供参考；为国家半导体战略和政策制定提供依据；为企业和研究机构的技术研发方向提供指导；为理解技术主权和国家安全问题提供分析框架；为应对技术极限挑战提供解决方案思路。

title: The Human-AI Contracting Paradox
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and The Wharton School - Operations, Information and Decisions Department

detail.title: The Human-AI Contracting Paradox
detail.abstract: The integration of state-of-the-art AI tools into professional workflows promises substantial productivity gains. Rather than replacing workers, there is hope that human-AI teams, which combine powerful machine capabilities with sound human judgment, can outperform humans or AI acting alone. Yet, unlike AI, the human requires compensation to put effort into the process. We consider human-AI collaboration with a principal-agent framework and reveal a "human-AI contracting paradox." Our model shows that, as AI tools become more reliable (i.e., failing rarely but unpredictably), motivating human vigilance to inspect and correct possible AI errors becomes prohibitively costly. Specifically, the required wage for the agent scales inversely with the error probability of the AI tool. This paradox creates adverse economic incentives, often prompting organizations to either limit the use of beneficial AI technologies or abandon human-AI collaboration altogether. If AI collaboration is reluctantly accepted, the principal perversely can prefer a less reliable tool. This friction arises solely from the inability to economically incentivize human oversight, rather than any inherent deficiencies in technological or human capabilities. More encouragingly, the principal can benefit from higher variance in AI output quality if the human is able to discern AI's suitability for a task. Our findings emphasize that effective human-AI collaboration depends not only on technological improvements but also crucially on addressing economic and contractual challenges.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了"人机协作合同悖论"：随着AI工具可靠性提高，激励人类监督AI错误的成本呈指数增长，导致组织要么限制AI使用，要么放弃人机协作，甚至偏好可靠性较低的AI工具。
AI.research_question: 在人类-AI协作中，如何通过合同设计激励人类有效监督AI错误？当AI工具可靠性提高时，经济激励如何影响人机协作的有效性？
AI.motivation: 虽然人机协作有望超越单独的人类或AI表现，但人类需要经济补偿来投入努力。现有研究忽视了激励人类监督AI错误的经济挑战，特别是在AI可靠性提高的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用委托-代理框架分析人机协作，引入"人机协作合同悖论"概念，探讨激励相容、监督成本和AI可靠性之间的权衡。
AI.method: 建立理论模型，分析AI错误概率与人类监督激励成本之间的关系，推导最优合同设计，考虑AI输出质量方差的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 激励人类监督AI错误的工资与AI错误概率成反比；2. AI可靠性提高反而使监督成本指数增长；3. 组织可能偏好可靠性较低的AI工具；4. AI输出质量方差高时，若人类能识别AI适用性，委托人可能受益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"人机协作合同悖论"理论；2. 将委托-代理框架应用于人机协作研究；3. 揭示技术可靠性与经济激励之间的张力；4. 扩展了人机协作的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒组织关注人机协作的经济激励问题；2. 建议设计更好的监督机制和合同安排；3. 指出不应盲目追求AI可靠性而忽视监督成本；4. 为政策制定者提供管理建议。

title: Overcoming barriers to ecological transition: a theoretical focus on stakeholder collaboration

detail.title: Overcoming barriers to ecological transition: a theoretical focus on stakeholder collaboration
detail.abstract: This study examines the crucial role of multi-stakeholder collaborations in advancing the ecological transition, focusing on the relational dynamics that facilitate or hinder these efforts. As key social actors, companies have a responsibility to address environmental and social challenges by integrating functions such as marketing, corporate responsibility, and sustainability to promote stakeholder engagement and the adoption of sustainable practices. Through a conceptual approach, the paper reviews existing literature and theoretical models on stakeholder engagement, ecological transition, and integration of internal business functions. It identifies barriers to effective multi-stakeholder collaboration, including competing interests, communication problems, and trust deficits, and offers strategies to address them. The Multi-Stakeholder Value Map is employed to evidence multi-level stakeholder relationships. It highlights that alignment of internal business functions, particularly marketing and accountability can improve external stakeholder engagement, promote shared responsibility, and play a significant role in driving the ecological transition. This integration is essential to overcome the barriers of multi-stakeholder collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨多利益相关方合作在推动生态转型中的关键作用，重点关注促进或阻碍这些努力的关系动态。通过概念性方法，识别了多利益相关方协作的障碍并提出了解决策略，强调企业内部职能整合对改善外部利益相关方参与和推动生态转型的重要性。
AI.research_question: 多利益相关方合作如何促进生态转型？企业内部职能整合（特别是营销与问责）如何改善外部利益相关方参与并推动生态转型？
AI.motivation: 企业作为关键社会行为体，有责任通过整合营销、企业责任和可持续发展等职能来解决环境和社会挑战，促进利益相关方参与和可持续实践的采用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关方参与理论、生态转型理论、企业内部职能整合理论、多利益相关方价值地图模型
AI.method: 概念性研究方法，通过文献综述和理论模型分析，回顾利益相关方参与、生态转型和企业内部职能整合的现有文献
AI.findings: 识别了多利益相关方协作的障碍包括：利益冲突、沟通问题和信任缺失；企业内部职能（特别是营销与问责）的协调可以改善外部利益相关方参与，促进共同责任，并在推动生态转型中发挥重要作用
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了多利益相关方合作与生态转型的理论框架，强调了企业内部职能整合对利益相关方参与的理论重要性，扩展了多利益相关方价值地图模型的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了克服多利益相关方协作障碍的策略，展示了如何通过整合营销、企业责任和可持续发展职能来促进生态转型，为管理者提供了改善利益相关方参与的具体方法

title: Default Judgment, Regulatory Overreach, and Media Ethics
affiliations: Diplomatic Trade Ltd

detail.title: Default Judgment, Regulatory Overreach, and Media Ethics
detail.abstract: This article examines the federal litigation in Ballout v. Prince, et al., Case No. 4:25-cv-12433-SDK-APP (E.D. Mich.), where judicial defaults have now been entered against journalist Todd Prince and Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty (RFE/RL), a U.S. Agency for Global Media (USAGM)-funded corporation. The default posture legally establishes the falsity of the reporting, the presence of actual malice, and the resulting harm. The case is further magnified by the fact that Prince's article was later relied upon by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to initiate an unsubstantiated civil enforcement action-also now under appeal and facing vacatur due to federal procedural violations. A parallel action has been filed against both the SEC and USAGM, creating a rare triad of legal accountability across journalism, regulation, and federal oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文分析Ballout v. Prince联邦诉讼案，该案中记者Todd Prince和RFE/RL因缺席判决被认定报道虚假、存在实际恶意并造成损害。案件重要性在于该报道被SEC用作无依据执法行动的依据，形成新闻、监管和联邦监督三重法律问责的罕见案例。
AI.research_question: 联邦诉讼中缺席判决如何确立新闻报道的虚假性、实际恶意和损害后果？当政府机构依赖此类报道进行执法时，会产生怎样的多重法律问责效应？
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于分析一个罕见的三重法律问责案例：1) 记者和媒体机构因虚假报道面临诽谤诉讼；2) 政府监管机构依赖虚假报道发起无依据执法行动；3) 联邦监督机构因资助问题媒体而面临问责。这种跨领域的法律连锁反应值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架基于：1) 诽谤法中的实际恶意原则（actual malice doctrine）；2) 行政法中的程序正当性理论；3) 媒体问责与政府监管的互动理论；4) 联邦机构监督责任理论。
AI.method: 采用案例分析法，深入剖析Ballout v. Prince联邦诉讼案的法律文件、缺席判决理由、SEC执法行动的上诉过程，以及针对SEC和USAGM的平行诉讼。通过法律文本分析和程序追踪，揭示多重问责机制。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) 缺席判决在法律上确立了报道的虚假性、实际恶意和损害；2) SEC依赖虚假报道发起的执法行动因程序违规面临撤销；3) 形成了新闻媒体、监管机构、联邦资助机构的三重问责链条；4) 揭示了政府机构过度依赖媒体报道进行执法的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1) 扩展了媒体问责理论，纳入政府机构依赖因素；2) 提出了"监管依赖虚假信息"的理论模型；3) 丰富了联邦机构监督责任的理论框架；4) 构建了跨领域法律问责的整合分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1) 为媒体机构提供报道准确性的警示；2) 为监管机构提供信息核查的实践指南；3) 为联邦资助机构建立媒体监督机制；4) 为法律实务界提供多重诉讼策略参考；5) 推动建立防止虚假信息在政府系统中传播的机制。

title: Posthumanism vs. Transhumanism: From the "End of Exceptionalism" to "Technological Humanism"
affiliations: Moscow State University

detail.title: Posthumanism vs. Transhumanism: From the "End of Exceptionalism" to "Technological Humanism"
detail.abstract: Posthumanism and transhumanism are often identified. However, modern researchers indicate the fundamental difference between these intellectual schools. The fundamental idea of posthumanism is the rejection of biological, ethical, and ontological anthropocentrism. Transhumanism focuses on changing and improving natural human characteristics through biological, technological, and cognitive modifications. While posthumanism draws attention to the crisis of humanism, transhumanism is the latter's heir. Scientific and ethical consequences of posthumanism, as well as the sociocultural potential of transhumanism, are considered in this article. Posthumanism carries risks of shifting the value focus from man to other objects, which in the long term can lead to a critical decrease in the value status of man. Transhumanism has the potential to preserve man as an effective economic and cognizing agent. It is suggested that Russian society has a sociocultural potential for moving towards "technological humanism.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了后人类主义与超人类主义的本质区别：后人类主义拒绝人类中心主义，关注人类主义危机；而超人类主义旨在通过技术增强人类能力，是人类主义的继承者。文章分析了后人类主义的科学伦理风险（可能降低人类价值地位）和超人类主义的社会文化潜力（保持人类作为经济与认知主体的有效性），并指出俄罗斯社会具备向"技术人文主义"发展的潜力。
AI.research_question: 后人类主义与超人类主义的本质区别是什么？这两种思想流派各自带来怎样的科学伦理后果与社会文化潜力？俄罗斯社会是否具备向"技术人文主义"发展的潜力？
AI.motivation: 当前学术界常将后人类主义与超人类主义混为一谈，但二者存在根本差异。理解这种差异对于评估它们对人类社会、伦理和文化的不同影响至关重要，特别是在技术快速发展的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 后人类主义理论：拒绝生物、伦理和本体论上的人类中心主义
2. 超人类主义理论：通过生物、技术和认知改造增强人类自然特性
3. 人类主义危机理论
4. 技术人文主义理论
AI.method: 理论分析与哲学思辨方法，通过概念辨析和逻辑论证比较两种思想流派的本质特征、理论基础和社会影响。
AI.findings:

title: The Paradox of Transparency: Multidimensional Signaling and Market Failure in Brand Collaborations
affiliations: Thammasat University, Thammasat University

detail.title: The Paradox of Transparency: Multidimensional Signaling and Market Failure in Brand Collaborations
detail.abstract: The pricing mechanisms of the digital economy are undergoing a fundamental paradigm shift from human decision-making to algorithmic autonomy. Modern algorithmic pricing systems possess the capability to adjust strategies on a millisecond timescale, presenting a "spiral oscillation" dilemma for traditional antitrust regulation. This paper models the interaction between regulators and algorithms as a strongly-convex-strongly-concave Min-Max game. Through spectral analysis, we uncover the mathematical mechanism whereby traditional "reactive regulation" falls into stagnation due to the indefiniteness of the system's Hessian matrix. Drawing inspiration from recent advances in non-convex optimization, we propose an adversarial regulatory mechanism based on "Hessian-Squared Estimation." Theoretical analysis and simulation experiments demonstrate that this mechanism achieves super-linear convergence independent of the problem's condition number by actively accumulating second-order information via stress testing. Furthermore, we propose an "Algorithmic Audit Sandbox" framework and a novel legal metric termed "Sensitivity Variance" (SV), providing an actionable technical foundation for future antitrust enforcement.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对算法定价系统带来的监管困境，提出了一种基于Hessian平方估计的对抗性监管机制，通过主动积累二阶信息实现超线性收敛，并设计了算法审计沙箱框架和敏感性方差法律指标。
AI.research_question: 如何有效监管具有毫秒级策略调整能力的算法定价系统，解决传统反垄断监管面临的"螺旋振荡"困境？
AI.motivation: 数字经济定价机制正从人类决策转向算法自主，现代算法定价系统能在毫秒级调整策略，导致传统"反应式监管"陷入停滞，形成监管困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将监管者与算法互动建模为强凸-强凹的Min-Max博弈，运用谱分析揭示传统监管失效的数学机制，借鉴非凸优化最新进展。
AI.method: 提出基于"Hessian平方估计"的对抗性监管机制，通过压力测试主动积累二阶信息；进行理论分析和模拟实验验证；设计"算法审计沙箱"框架和"敏感性方差"法律指标。
AI.findings: 传统"反应式监管"因系统Hessian矩阵的不定性而陷入停滞；提出的对抗性监管机制能实现与问题条件数无关的超线性收敛；算法审计沙箱和敏感性方差指标为反垄断执法提供可行技术基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了算法监管困境的数学机制（Hessian矩阵不定性）；提出了基于非凸优化理论的对抗性监管新范式；发展了算法监管的博弈论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的"Hessian平方估计"监管机制；设计了"算法审计沙箱"实施框架；提出了"敏感性方差"这一新型法律度量指标，为反垄断执法提供技术工具。

title: Impact of Government Subsidy on Green Product Innovation
affiliations: , Hong Kong Polytechnic University - Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies, Anhui University and Hong Kong Polytechnic University - Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies

detail.title: Impact of Government Subsidy on Green Product Innovation
detail.abstract: Encouraging green product innovation is essential for governments to address environmental challenges, with subsidies playing a crucial role. Meanwhile, consumers’ willingness to pay a premium for green products is increasing, providing additional market incentives. Therefore, understanding how government and market incentives jointly affect green product innovation is crucial. This paper develops a game-theoretic model to explore the optimal subsidy policy for a government to stimulate green product innovation from a firm. Specifically, we examine three types of government subsidies: research and development (R&D), production, and consumer subsidies, which respectively aim at reducing firms’ R&D costs, production costs, and consumers’ purchase costs of green products. Our results suggest that green product innovation can only be stimulated under high R&D costs if either government or market incentives are sufficiently strong. In addition, subsidizing different recipients makes a significant difference: Compared to production and R&D subsidies, consumer subsidies require the lowest budget to spur innovation; however, for a given budget, R&D subsidies result in the highest green technology level. Our findings also reveal that a welfare-maximizing government tends to subsidize R&D when prioritizing environmental protection, and consumers when emphasizing economic performance. Finally, we show that a subsidy portfolio can enhance social welfare compared to a single scheme, but may not always increase firm profit or environmental benefit, depending on policy priorities. These findings could offer new managerial insights for designing effective subsidy policies to promote green innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论模型分析政府补贴如何与市场激励共同影响企业绿色产品创新，比较了研发、生产和消费者三种补贴方式的效果差异，为政府设计有效补贴政策提供新见解。
AI.research_question: 政府补贴（研发、生产、消费者补贴）如何与市场激励（消费者支付意愿）共同影响企业绿色产品创新？不同补贴方式的效果差异是什么？
AI.motivation: 绿色产品创新对解决环境挑战至关重要，政府补贴在其中发挥关键作用。同时，消费者对绿色产品的支付意愿增加提供了市场激励。需要理解政府与市场激励如何共同影响绿色创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，分析政府与企业之间的策略互动，考虑研发成本、生产成本、消费者支付意愿等关键因素。
AI.method: 建立博弈论模型，分析三种政府补贴方式（研发补贴、生产补贴、消费者补贴）对企业绿色产品创新的影响，比较不同补贴策略的效果。
AI.findings: 1. 绿色产品创新只有在高研发成本下，当政府或市场激励足够强时才能被激发；2. 消费者补贴所需预算最低，但给定预算下研发补贴能实现最高的绿色技术水平；3. 福利最大化政府优先环保时倾向补贴研发，重视经济表现时倾向补贴消费者；4. 补贴组合能提高社会福利，但不一定增加企业利润或环境效益，取决于政策优先级。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了政府补贴与市场激励共同影响绿色创新的理论框架；2. 系统比较了三种补贴方式的效果差异；3. 揭示了补贴政策设计中的权衡关系；4. 为绿色创新政策研究提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政府设计绿色创新补贴政策提供具体指导；2. 帮助政策制定者根据环保或经济优先目标选择合适补贴方式；3. 提供了预算约束下的最优补贴策略建议；4. 揭示了补贴组合的潜在效果与局限性。

affiliations: and Anna Adarsh College for Women

detail.abstract: 'Artificial Intelligence' and 'hyper-personalisation'-These two terms have gained significant prominence in recent times. AI & hyperpersonalisation has created a revolution in the marketing industry. They have evolved as a radical force across all industries including global trade. With the surge in internet availability, the customers of today are more connected through digital platforms, so is the international trade and commerce. Traditional way of trade involved static supply chains and mass marketing. With the advent of AI & hyper-personalisation these approaches have changed. Today's trade and commerce focusses more on individual consumer. AI which can process huge amount of data in no time is restructuring global trade by improving supply chain network, boosting market intelligence & by enhanced decision-making. Hyper-personalisation with the help of AI assists in making tailored recommendations to the consumers even at a global level. This paper primarily focusses on how AI & hyper-personalisation are transcending global trade.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能和超个性化如何变革全球贸易，从传统静态供应链和大众营销转向以个体消费者为中心，通过AI处理海量数据优化供应链、增强市场情报和决策能力，实现全球层面的个性化推荐。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和超个性化如何超越和变革全球贸易？
AI.motivation: 随着互联网普及和数字平台发展，消费者连接性增强，传统静态供应链和大众营销方式已不适应现代全球贸易需求，AI和超个性化技术为行业带来革命性变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字化转型理论、供应链优化理论和个性化营销理论，探讨AI技术在全球贸易中的应用框架。
AI.method: 概念性分析论文，通过文献综述和理论分析探讨AI和超个性化在全球贸易中的变革作用。
AI.findings: AI通过处理海量数据重构全球贸易，改善供应链网络，提升市场情报和决策能力；超个性化借助AI实现全球层面的定制化推荐，使贸易从大众营销转向以个体消费者为中心。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了AI和超个性化在全球贸易中的理论框架，拓展了数字化转型理论在贸易领域的应用，为理解技术驱动的贸易变革提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球贸易企业提供AI和超个性化应用指导，帮助企业优化供应链、提升市场竞争力，实现从传统贸易模式向数字化、个性化贸易模式的转型。

title: Symbolic Governance for Probabilistic Intelligence: Why Governable AI Requires Symbolic Structure Without Reverting to Symbolic AI

detail.title: Symbolic Governance for Probabilistic Intelligence: Why Governable AI Requires Symbolic Structure Without Reverting to Symbolic AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or commercial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest with respect to the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not involve human subjects, personal data, patient information, or experimental interventions. As a theoretical and architectural analysis, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was independently conducted and self-funded by the author. No grants, institutional funding, or third-party sponsorship supported this research.

detail.abstract:
The rapid deployment of probabilistic AI systems—large language models, autonomous agents, and tool-calling workflows—has created a governance gap that existing mechanisms cannot close. These systems generate outputs through statistical inference, but they cannot deterministically explain specific outcomes, guarantee repeatability, verify compliance with external constraints, or prove that consequential actions were authorized by a legitimate authority.

Current approaches treat governance as a property of the AI model itself, relying on alignment, prompt-based guardrails, or human-in-the-loop review. These methods provide statistical influence over behavior but cannot deliver the deterministic guarantees required for regulated environments.

This paper argues that governable AI requires an architectural separation between intelligence and governance. Probabilistic systems are well-suited to proposal generation; authorization must occur through a distinct, deterministic, replayable, and verifiable mechanism. We introduce the FERZ architecture, which wraps probabilistic AI systems in a deterministic enforcement layer and formalizes Proof-Carrying Decisions (PCDs)—decision artifacts that carry the evidence necessary for independent verification.

By treating symbolic structure as governance infrastructure rather than a theory of intelligence, FERZ enables fail-closed enforcement, replayable audits, and verifiable authority without reverting to symbolic AI. The result is a deployable governance architecture for high-stakes, regulated AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FERZ架构，通过将概率性AI系统包裹在确定性执行层中，实现智能与治理的架构分离，为高风险、受监管的AI系统提供可部署的治理架构。
AI.research_question: 如何为概率性AI系统（如大语言模型、自主代理）构建能够提供确定性保证的治理架构，以填补现有治理机制无法解决的治理空白？
AI.motivation: 概率性AI系统的快速部署（大语言模型、自主代理、工具调用工作流）产生了现有机制无法填补的治理空白。这些系统通过统计推断生成输出，但无法确定性地解释具体结果、保证可重复性、验证外部约束合规性或证明关键行动得到合法授权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智能与治理的架构分离理论：概率性系统适合提案生成，而授权必须通过独立的、确定性的、可重放和可验证的机制进行。证明承载决策（PCDs）理论：决策工件携带独立验证所需的证据。
AI.method: 提出FERZ架构，将概率性AI系统包裹在确定性执行层中，将符号结构作为治理基础设施而非智能理论，实现故障关闭执行、可重放审计和可验证授权。
AI.findings: 通过FERZ架构，可以实现：1）智能与治理的架构分离；2）确定性治理保证；3）可重放审计；4）可验证授权；5）无需回归符号AI即可实现治理基础设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出智能与治理架构分离的理论框架；2）形式化证明承载决策（PCDs）概念；3）重新定义符号结构在AI治理中的角色（作为基础设施而非智能理论）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供可部署的治理架构FERZ；2）为高风险、受监管的AI系统提供确定性保证；3）支持故障关闭执行机制；4）实现可重放审计和独立验证能力。

title: The Enterprise AI Governance Buyer's Guide

detail.title: The Enterprise AI Governance Buyer's Guide

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of FERZ AI, a company that develops deterministic AI governance infrastructure. The framework presented in this paper is vendor-neutral and is intended to support independent evaluation of AI governance claims across the market. No external parties influenced the analysis or conclusions presented.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental subjects. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence increasingly fails not because AI models lack capability, but because organizations cannot prove that governance controls were functioning correctly at the moment a decision was made. Most AI governance solutions marketed as “guardrails,” “responsible AI,” or “trustworthy AI” rely on probabilistic techniques that provide statistical confidence but cannot produce post-incident proof.

This paper introduces a vendor-neutral framework for evaluating AI governance solutions based on evidentiary rigor rather than marketing claims. It distinguishes probabilistic governance approaches from deterministic, fail-closed governance systems capable of producing independently verifiable audit artifacts. The framework formalizes the Four Tests Standard (4TS)—Reproducibility, Verifiability, Completeness, and Boundedness—and proposes a baseline qualification gate requiring third-party replay of historical governance decisions.

The guide provides practical due-diligence questions for procurement teams, risk officers, General Counsel, and technical evaluators, along with example proof-carrying decision artifacts mapped to common regulatory requirements. The analysis emphasizes liability allocation, auditability, and regulatory defensibility in high-stakes and regulated environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于证据严谨性的AI治理解决方案评估框架，区分概率性治理方法与确定性、故障关闭治理系统，并制定了四测试标准（4TS）作为评估基准。
AI.research_question: 如何评估AI治理解决方案的有效性，特别是在产生可独立验证的审计证据方面，以解决企业AI采用中的治理控制证明问题？
AI.motivation: 企业AI采用失败往往不是因为AI模型能力不足，而是因为组织无法证明在决策时刻治理控制功能正常运行。现有AI治理解决方案（如"护栏"、"负责任AI"、"可信AI"）大多依赖概率性技术，只能提供统计置信度，无法产生事后证明。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 证据严谨性框架：区分概率性治理方法与确定性、故障关闭治理系统
2. 四测试标准（4TS）：可重现性、可验证性、完整性、有界性
3. 第三方历史治理决策重放作为基线资格门槛
AI.method: 提出一个供应商中立的评估框架，基于证据严谨性而非营销声明。框架形式化四测试标准，并建立基线资格要求。提供实际尽职调查问题清单和证明承载决策工件的示例。
AI.findings:
1. 现有AI治理解决方案大多无法产生独立可验证的审计证据
2. 确定性、故障关闭治理系统能够产生证明承载决策工件
3. 四测试标准为评估治理解决方案提供了系统化方法
4. 第三方重放历史治理决策是验证治理有效性的关键测试
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了基于证据严谨性的AI治理评估理论框架
2. 形式化了四测试标准（4TS）作为评估基准
3. 区分了概率性与确定性治理方法的理论差异
4. 提出了证明承载决策工件的概念框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为采购团队、风险官员、总法律顾问和技术评估人员提供实际尽职调查问题
2. 提供映射到常见监管要求的证明承载决策工件示例
3. 强调在高风险和受监管环境中的责任分配、可审计性和监管防御性
4. 建立第三方重放测试作为采购决策的实践标准

title: Governance structures for long-term digital transformation: an agent-based simulation approach
affiliations: Arkansas State University

detail.title: Governance structures for long-term digital transformation: an agent-based simulation approach
detail.abstract: As organizations undergo long-term digital transformation, the role of governance structures in shaping performance, capability evolution, and workforce adaptation becomes increasingly relevant. This study develops an agent-based analytical model to investigate how hierarchical, decentralized, and hybrid governance structures influence digital transformation outcomes over time. The model captures key organizational dynamics, including resource allocation efficiency, capability development, employee effort adaptation, and governance-induced inefficiencies, and is validated through a numerical experiment. The results reveal that decentralized governance promotes the highest long-term transformation success, as it maximizes capability growth, sustains high employee effort, and ensures efficient resource utilization. In contrast, hierarchical governance limits digital adaptability, imposing rigid structures that slow workforce responsiveness and reduce performance. Hybrid governance strikes a balance by combining structured oversight with flexibility and enabling moderate but stable transformation success. The study further highlights the importance of dynamic governance mechanisms, where organizations should adapt governance models over time to align with evolving technological and market conditions. The findings provide practical guidance for organizations, policymakers, and business leaders in designing governance structures that optimize digital transformation

AI.tldr: 本研究通过基于代理的分析模型发现，去中心化治理结构在长期数字化转型中表现最佳，能最大化能力增长、维持员工努力并确保资源高效利用；层级制治理限制数字适应性；混合治理提供平衡但适中的转型成功。
AI.research_question: 不同治理结构（层级制、去中心化、混合型）如何影响组织数字化转型的长期绩效、能力演化和员工适应？
AI.motivation: 随着组织进行长期数字化转型，治理结构在塑造绩效、能力演化和员工适应方面的作用日益重要，但不同治理结构对数字化转型结果的影响机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织治理理论、数字化转型理论、基于代理的建模理论、组织动态能力理论
AI.method: 基于代理的分析模型，捕捉资源分配效率、能力发展、员工努力适应和治理引致的低效率等关键组织动态，并通过数值实验进行验证。
AI.findings: 1. 去中心化治理促进最高的长期转型成功，最大化能力增长，维持高员工努力，确保高效资源利用；2. 层级制治理限制数字适应性，僵化结构减缓员工响应速度并降低绩效；3. 混合治理通过结合结构化监督与灵活性，实现适度但稳定的转型成功；4. 动态治理机制的重要性，组织应随时间调整治理模式以适应技术和市场条件变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了治理结构与数字化转型结果之间的理论联系；2. 揭示了不同治理结构影响数字化转型的动态机制；3. 提出了动态治理适应性的理论框架；4. 丰富了基于代理的组织变革模型理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织设计优化数字化转型的治理结构提供实践指导；2. 帮助政策制定者和商业领袖理解治理结构对转型成功的影响；3. 建议组织采用动态治理机制，根据技术和市场变化调整治理模式；4. 为组织在不同转型阶段选择合适治理结构提供决策依据。

title: Intellinomics: A Foundational Framework for Intelligence-Driven Economic Transformation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Intellinomics: A Foundational Framework for Intelligence-Driven Economic Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This paper is an independent academic contribution and has not been influenced by any external entity of funding sources
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this conceptual and theoretical paper, as id does not involve human subjects, personal data, or experimental procedures
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, public institution, or private organization

detail.abstract: This paper introduces and establishes Intellinomics, a new conceptual framework coined by Dr. Ziad Alzaidi (2025) to define the emerging phase of global economic transformation driven by artificial intelligence (AI), advanced computational infrastructures, sovereign data systems, and algorithmic decision-making. While existing frameworks such as the Knowledge Economy, Digital Economy, Platform Economy, Data Economy, Algorithmic Economy, and Cognitive Economy have each illuminated earlier transitions in the digital revolution, none fully capture the structural integration of machine intelligence into macroeconomic systems. Intellinomics conceptualizes AI not as a technological layer but as a new productive factor, a strategic asset, and a geopolitical lever with direct implications for national competitiveness, fiscal governance, labour markets, productivity growth, and economic resilience. The paper synthesizes evidence from leading institutions-including the OECD, IMF, World Bank, McKinsey Global Institute, Stanford HAI, MIT CSAIL, and Bloomberg Economics-to examine how AI reshapes global value chains, energy systems, sovereign compute capacity, scientific discovery, and economic diversification, with a special focus on Middle Eastern economies navigating post-hydrocarbon transitions. It argues that Intellinomics offers a necessary analytical lens for policymakers, economists, and strategic planners to understand and design the intelligence-driven economy of the 21st century.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Intellinomics（智能经济学）这一新概念框架，由Ziad Alzaidi博士（2025）提出，用于定义由人工智能、先进计算基础设施、主权数据系统和算法决策驱动的全球经济转型新阶段。该框架将AI视为新的生产要素、战略资产和地缘政治杠杆，而非单纯的技术层。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够充分捕捉机器智能与宏观经济系统结构性整合的新概念框架，以理解和设计21世纪的智能驱动型经济？
AI.motivation: 现有框架如知识经济、数字经济、平台经济、数据经济、算法经济和认知经济虽然各自阐明了数字革命的不同阶段，但都无法完全捕捉机器智能与宏观经济系统的结构性整合。需要一个新的分析框架来理解AI作为生产要素、战略资产和地缘政治杠杆的全面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Intellinomics（智能经济学）作为核心理论框架，将AI概念化为新的生产要素、战略资产和地缘政治杠杆。该框架整合了知识经济、数字经济、平台经济、数据经济、算法经济和认知经济等现有理论，但超越了它们的技术层视角。
AI.method: 综合分析方法：整合来自OECD、IMF、世界银行、麦肯锡全球研究所、斯坦福HAI、MIT CSAIL和彭博经济学等领先机构的证据，研究AI如何重塑全球价值链、能源系统、主权计算能力、科学发现和经济多元化。
AI.findings: AI正在深刻重塑全球价值链、能源系统、主权计算能力、科学发现和经济多元化。Intellinomics为理解AI对国家竞争力、财政治理、劳动力市场、生产率增长和经济韧性的直接影响提供了必要的分析视角，特别适用于中东经济体在后碳氢化合物转型中的战略规划。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Intellinomics这一新的概念框架，填补了现有经济理论在捕捉机器智能与宏观经济系统结构性整合方面的空白。将AI从技术层提升为新的生产要素、战略资产和地缘政治杠杆，为经济学理论发展提供了新的方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、经济学家和战略规划者提供了理解和设计21世纪智能驱动型经济的分析工具。特别有助于中东经济体在后碳氢化合物转型中制定基于AI的经济战略，提升国家竞争力和经济韧性。

title: Digital Transformation of Human Resources: From Consulting Frameworks to AI-Enabled Learning Management Systems
affiliations: WuXi Biologics, Hengsheng Telecom, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory and WuXi Biologics

detail.title: Digital Transformation of Human Resources: From Consulting Frameworks to AI-Enabled Learning Management Systems
detail.abstract: Digital transformation is reshaping corporate human resources management models. This paper synthesizes consulting and implementation cases across multiple industries (energy, medical devices, FMCG) to explore digital practices using Workday and Saba Learning Management Systems (LMS). Research methods include machine learning clustering and logistic regression analysis of learning behavior data from 3,500 users. Combined with Kotter's eight-step change management model, this evaluates the implementation effectiveness of digital projects. Results indicate that competency-based LMS significantly enhances the correlation between learning and performance: high-learning-credit groups achieved an 18% performance improvement rate and a 12% increase in employee retention. Regarding organizational transformation, process standardization and cross-regional collaboration efficiency increased by 25%, while user satisfaction rose by 20%. This study not only demonstrates the value of AI-powered LMS in enhancing talent development but also provides methodological references for enterprises advancing HR strategies in the digital context.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析多个行业的数字化转型案例，探讨了基于Workday和Saba学习管理系统(LMS)的数字化实践。研究发现，基于能力的学习管理系统能显著提升学习与绩效的关联性，高学分群体绩效提升18%，员工保留率提高12%。组织转型方面，流程标准化和跨区域协作效率提升25%，用户满意度提高20%。
AI.research_question: 数字化转型如何重塑企业人力资源管理模型？基于能力的学习管理系统(LMS)如何影响学习与绩效的关联性以及组织转型效果？
AI.motivation: 数字化转型正在重塑企业人力资源管理模型，但具体实践效果和影响机制尚不明确。研究旨在探索数字化人力资源管理的实际应用效果，为企业提供数字化转型的参考依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kotter八步变革管理模型；基于能力的学习管理系统理论；数字化转型理论；人力资源管理理论
AI.method: 多行业案例研究（能源、医疗器械、快消品行业）；机器学习聚类分析；逻辑回归分析；基于3500名用户学习行为数据的实证分析；结合Kotter变革管理模型的实施效果评估
AI.findings:
1. 基于能力的学习管理系统显著增强学习与绩效的关联性：高学分群体绩效提升18%，员工保留率提高12%
2. 组织转型效果显著：流程标准化和跨区域协作效率提升25%，用户满意度提高20%
3. AI驱动的LMS在人才发展方面具有重要价值
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将Kotter变革管理模型应用于数字化转型评估，拓展了变革管理理论的应用范围
2. 验证了基于能力的学习管理系统对学习-绩效关联性的理论假设
3. 为数字化转型背景下的人力资源管理理论发展提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业推进人力资源数字化转型提供了方法论参考
2. 展示了AI驱动的学习管理系统在提升员工绩效和保留率方面的实际效果
3. 提供了跨行业数字化转型的最佳实践案例，帮助企业制定有效的HR数字化战略

title: Raising Thresholds' Hidden Impacts
affiliations: George Washington University - Law School

detail.title: Raising Thresholds' Hidden Impacts

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Law School Public Law Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: A quiet change in federal spending thresholds has reshaped who holds power in government contracting. When the calendar turned October 1, 2025, a policy shift increased the micro-purchase and simplified acquisition thresholds with the intention to accelerate purchasing and reduce administrative burden, yet they also shift the balance between efficiency, transparency, and equity. This paper examines how these changes are influencing small-business participation, oversight dynamics, and the long-term health of the industrial base. It discusses how executional controls, category management, and size standard reforms will impact whether the higher thresholds result in more opportunity or hoarding by incumbents. In the end, it will be how contracting officers and oversight agencies use the thresholds in day-to-day practice that will determine whether speed and equity will be maintained in the federal marketplace.

AI.tldr: 联邦采购门槛提高旨在加速采购、减少行政负担，但可能影响小企业参与、监管平衡和产业基础健康，最终效果取决于采购官员和监管机构的日常实践。
AI.research_question: 联邦采购门槛提高如何影响小企业参与、监管动态和产业基础长期健康？
AI.motivation: 联邦采购门槛政策变化旨在提高效率，但可能影响透明度、公平性和市场参与平衡，需要研究其实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采购政策理论、监管平衡理论、市场参与理论、制度执行理论
AI.method: 政策分析、案例研究、实证数据分析（可能涉及采购数据、企业参与数据等）
AI.findings: 门槛提高可能加速采购但影响小企业参与机会；执行控制、品类管理和规模标准改革将影响最终效果；日常实践决定效率与公平的平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对采购政策执行中效率-透明度-公平性权衡的理解；扩展制度执行理论在政府采购领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供门槛调整的实际影响评估；为采购官员和监管机构提供实践指导；帮助小企业应对政策变化。

detail.abstract:
ThiThis book aims to present new advanced technologies for the twenty-first century, focusing on new electric power generation systems, quantum computation, and high-performance transportation for the future. The book is divided into twelve chapters, each addressing a key technological domain and its implications for economic development, industrial transformation, and societal change.

The first part of the book explores emerging electric power generation technologies, including high-efficiency generators, sustainable energy systems, and intelligent grid architectures, emphasizing their role in supporting growing global energy demand while minimizing environmental impact. The second part focuses on quantum computation and next-generation information processing systems, analyzing their potential to revolutionize data processing, cryptography, optimization, and artificial intelligence through unprecedented computational speed and problem-solving capabilities. The third part examines future transportation systems, including electric, autonomous, and high-performance mobility platforms, highlighting their impact on logistics, urban design, and global connectivity.

By integrating technological, economic, and systemic perspectives, this book provides a multidimensional framework for understanding how these innovations interact and reinforce one another. The analysis combines theoretical foundations, engineering principles, and applied case studies to offer readers a comprehensive view of how advanced technologies are reshaping production systems, markets, and human activity. This book is intended for researchers, policymakers, engineers, and students who seek to understand the technological forces shaping the future and to engage critically with the opportunities and challenges of the next technological frontier.

AI.tldr: 本书探讨21世纪三大前沿技术领域：新型电力发电系统、量子计算和高性能运输系统，分析它们如何相互作用并重塑经济、产业和社会结构。
AI.research_question: 21世纪三大前沿技术领域（新型电力发电系统、量子计算、高性能运输）如何相互作用并共同塑造未来的经济、产业和社会结构？
AI.motivation: 面对全球能源需求增长、环境挑战、计算能力瓶颈和运输效率问题，需要理解新兴技术如何协同作用以推动可持续发展和社会变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术系统理论、创新系统理论、技术经济范式理论、可持续发展理论、系统集成理论
AI.method: 多维框架分析，结合理论基础、工程原理和应用案例研究，采用技术、经济、系统视角的整合方法
AI.findings: 1）高效发电和智能电网支持能源需求同时减少环境影响；2）量子计算将革命性改变数据处理、密码学、优化和人工智能；3）未来运输系统将重塑物流、城市设计和全球连接；4）这些技术相互增强，形成协同效应
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了理解前沿技术协同作用的多维框架，整合了技术系统、创新系统和可持续发展理论，为技术经济范式转变提供了新的分析视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员、政策制定者、工程师和学生提供理解未来技术趋势的综合指南，帮助识别技术协同机会，指导产业转型战略，支持可持续发展决策

title: SBCM Economics Part 2: Dynamic Meso-Economics and the Thermodynamics of Governance -From Static Algebra to Dynamic Calculus: The Thermodynamics of Governance

detail.title: SBCM Economics Part 2: Dynamic Meso-Economics and the Thermodynamics of Governance -From Static Algebra to Dynamic Calculus: The Thermodynamics of Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research was conducted independently as part of the SBCM Alliance project, a non-profit initiative for algorithmic governance.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzes only publicly available statistical data (Open Data from the Japanese Government) and does not involve human participants or animal experiments.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Traditional macroeconomics has treated the nation state as a rigid body, ignoring internal structural fatigue. This study updates the "Meso-Economics" framework proposed in v1 by introducing the concept of Time () and Infinity (). By evolving the Standard Block Comparison Method (SBCM) from static algebra to dynamic calculus, we prove that current fiscal policies in depopulating nations are mathematically equivalent to a "Ponzi scheme." Furthermore, we define "Algorithmic Public Interestism," a new governance protocol that replaces moral-based policy with physics-based constraints.

AI.tldr: 该研究将传统宏观经济学的国家视为刚体模型更新为考虑内部结构疲劳的动力学模型，引入时间和无限性概念，证明人口减少国家的财政政策在数学上等同于庞氏骗局，并提出基于物理约束的"算法公共利益主义"治理协议。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑时间和无限性因素的动态框架下，重新评估人口减少国家的财政政策可持续性，并提出基于物理约束的替代治理方案？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济学将国家视为刚体，忽略了内部结构疲劳问题，特别是在人口减少国家中，现行财政政策可能隐藏着系统性风险，需要新的分析框架来揭示这些风险并提出解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中观经济学框架（Meso-Economics）的更新版本，引入时间（Time）和无限性（Infinity）概念，将静态代数方法的标准区块比较法（SBCM）发展为动态微积分方法。
AI.method: 通过将标准区块比较法从静态代数演化为动态微积分，建立数学模型，证明人口减少国家财政政策与庞氏骗局的数学等价性，并基于物理约束设计新的治理协议。
AI.findings: 当前人口减少国家的财政政策在数学上等同于庞氏骗局，传统基于道德的治理模式存在根本缺陷，需要转向基于物理约束的算法治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了中观经济学框架，引入时间和无限性维度；2. 建立了财政政策可持续性的动态评估模型；3. 提出了算法公共利益主义作为新的治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了识别财政政策风险的量化工具；2. 提出了替代传统治理模式的算法治理协议；3. 为人口减少国家的政策设计提供了基于物理约束的新范式。

title: The Institutional Crypto Bet: Are Early Adopters Buying at the Wrong Time?
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: The Institutional Crypto Bet: Are Early Adopters Buying at the Wrong Time?
detail.abstract: This analysis examines whether institutional investors are allocating to Bitcoin ETFs just as their diversification benefits are diminishing. While early research found Bitcoin had near-zero correlation with traditional assets (approximately 0.04 with the S&P 500 from 2010-2013), recent data from 2024-2025 reveals a stark change: Bitcoin ETF correlations with equities have risen to approximately 0.39, nearly ten times higher, and reached 0.49 by late 2025. As major pensions and endowments begin cautious allocations, this evolving correlation structure raises important questions about Modern Portfolio Theory's application to cryptocurrency and whether institutions are entering at an inopportune time for diversification.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析机构投资者是否在比特币ETF多元化收益减少时才开始配置。早期比特币与传统资产相关性接近零，但2024-2025年比特币ETF与股票相关性升至0.39-0.49，增长近10倍。随着养老基金和捐赠基金开始谨慎配置，这种变化对现代投资组合理论在加密货币的应用提出质疑。
AI.research_question: 机构投资者是否在比特币ETF的多元化收益减少时才开始配置？这种时机选择是否恰当？
AI.motivation: 随着主要养老基金和捐赠基金开始对比特币ETF进行谨慎配置，但比特币与传统资产的相关性结构正在发生显著变化，这引发了关于机构投资者入场时机是否合适的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代投资组合理论（Modern Portfolio Theory），特别是资产多元化和相关性在投资组合构建中的作用。
AI.method: 相关性分析，比较2010-2013年（早期）与2024-2025年（近期）比特币/比特币ETF与传统资产（特别是标普500指数）的相关性数据。
AI.findings: 1. 早期（2010-2013）比特币与标普500相关性约为0.04，接近零相关；2. 近期（2024-2025）比特币ETF与股票相关性升至约0.39，增长近10倍；3. 到2025年底相关性进一步升至0.49；4. 机构投资者在相关性显著上升后才开始配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战现代投资组合理论在加密货币领域的应用，提出动态相关性结构对多元化策略的影响，强调时机选择在加密货币投资中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供关于比特币ETF配置时机的警示，建议在评估加密货币多元化收益时考虑相关性结构的变化，帮助投资决策者避免在多元化收益减少时入场。

title: Ethical Challenges and Algorithmic Bias in Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Ethical Challenges and Algorithmic Bias in Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no confilict of interest in relation to this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The author confirms that this research did not involve human participants, animal experimentation, or any use of identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethical approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no funding.

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly growing and becoming an increasingly important part of many industries, but it also raises significant ethical and social concerns. This paper looks at how algorithmic bias, which can come from bad data, poor sampling, labeling mistakes, and old patterns in society, can make unfairness worse in AI systems. These problems are not random but show deeper social issues that affect fairness, trust, and accountability. The paper explains how a lack of openness and oversight makes it hard to find and fix bias. To solve these issues, researchers suggest using clear data practices, regular checks on algorithms, and strong legal and ethical rules. Building fairness into AI from the start is key to making it more trustworthy. In the end, the paper argues that responsible and transparent AI can help technology support fairness and honesty in society.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了人工智能中的算法偏见问题，分析了偏见来源（不良数据、抽样问题、标签错误、社会固有模式），指出这些偏见会加剧AI系统的不公平性，并提出了通过透明数据实践、算法审计和法规框架来构建公平AI的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 算法偏见如何加剧人工智能系统中的不公平性，以及如何通过技术、伦理和法律手段来缓解这种偏见？
AI.motivation: 人工智能在各行业的快速发展和广泛应用带来了显著的伦理和社会问题，特别是算法偏见会强化和加剧社会中的不公平现象，影响公平性、信任和问责制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于算法公平性理论、技术伦理框架和社会技术系统理论，探讨偏见如何从数据收集、算法设计到系统部署的各个环节产生和传播。
AI.method: 概念分析框架，通过文献综述和理论分析，识别算法偏见的来源（数据质量、抽样偏差、标签错误、社会模式），并提出系统性解决方案。
AI.findings: 算法偏见主要来源于四个层面：不良数据、抽样问题、标签错误和社会固有模式；缺乏透明度和监督机制使得偏见难以检测和纠正；这些偏见不是随机的，而是反映了深层的社会不平等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了算法偏见的系统性分析框架，将技术问题与社会结构问题联系起来，为理解AI公平性提供了更全面的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用透明数据实践、定期算法审计、建立法律和伦理框架，以及将公平性设计原则嵌入AI开发全流程，以构建更可信赖的人工智能系统。

title: Single Equation Time Series Models and Forecasting: Management Practice

detail.title: Single Equation Time Series Models and Forecasting: Management Practice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Never
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Self

detail.abstract:
Autoregressive models are for a series with values correlated in time. The value is related to one or several values in the past. Any factors that allow for the correlation are not significant. It is a study of the variable in time. It is not panel data with several characteristics but only a series. A combination of impact of one variable model correlated to its earlier values in time, linkages with international trade and macroeconomics theory, and its implementation in AI / ML and code can generate evolved management practice. AI refers to Artificial Intelligence and ML to Machine Learning.

For national product, we see an implementation of Kalman Filter. This is an advanced form of estimation and modelling. This is a single equation model in time.

A study of Prebisch Singer Hypothesis as Single Equation Time Series Model:

If price of primary products is the variable, the real exchange value in terms of manufactured products declines. The price depends on price in earlier time units. The price can be represented as its real exchange value in terms of manufacturing industry products imported. The price estimate is the estimate dependent on past values. An increase of export value requires that the terms only improve through this trade or other product or services manufacture, consumption and trade. A simultaneous higher value commodity export is sought for the terms of trade to only improve. Nations generally do not have that many commodities for export. One country one export product in terms of it being the largest producer of the commodity is a norm for international trade. Change of commodity is thus not a possibility. We then have a value addition product export strategy as the only success story. It is the value chain.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究单方程时间序列模型在分析初级产品价格长期趋势中的应用，结合普雷维什-辛格假说，探讨发展中国家通过价值链升级改善贸易条件的策略。
AI.research_question: 如何利用单方程时间序列模型验证普雷维什-辛格假说，并分析发展中国家通过价值链升级改善贸易条件的路径？
AI.motivation: 传统国际贸易理论未能充分解释发展中国家初级产品出口的长期不利趋势，需要结合时间序列分析和AI/ML技术来研究贸易条件动态变化，为管理实践提供新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 普雷维什-辛格假说、自回归时间序列模型、卡尔曼滤波估计、国际贸易理论、宏观经济理论、价值链理论。
AI.method: 单方程时间序列模型（自回归模型），卡尔曼滤波估计方法，结合AI/ML技术进行建模和预测。
AI.findings: 初级产品价格相对于制成品呈长期下降趋势；发展中国家难以通过商品转换改善贸易条件；价值链升级是唯一可行的成功策略；时间序列模型能有效捕捉价格动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将时间序列分析方法与普雷维什-辛格假说结合；扩展了自回归模型在国际贸易研究中的应用；为发展经济学提供了新的实证分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家制定贸易政策提供分析工具；通过AI/ML技术实现更精准的贸易条件预测；为管理实践提供基于数据驱动的决策支持；强调价值链升级的战略重要性。

title: Impact of Organisational Justice on Employees' Burnout and Workplace Cynicism in DHL International Ltd in South-West, Nigeria
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Impact of Organisational Justice on Employees' Burnout and Workplace Cynicism in DHL International Ltd in South-West, Nigeria
detail.abstract: This study investigated how distributive, procedural and interactional justice are practiced in DHL International Ltd in SouthWest Nigeria and examined their combined and relative effects on employees' burnout and workplace cynicism. Using data from 212 employees selected through stratified sampling across six states, the study assessed burnout dimensions (emotional exhaustion, depersonalisation and personal accomplishment) and cynicism components (cognitive, affective and behavioural) through standardised questionnaires. Descriptive and inferential analyses, including regression, correlation, t-tests and chisquare, showed that organisational justice strongly predicted burnout (R = .895) and workplace cynicism (R = .635). Higher justice perceptions were associated with reduced burnout and lower levels of cynicism, with procedural-interactional justice emerging most influential. The study concludes that fairness in organisational processes and interpersonal treatment plays a crucial role in reducing negative employee outcomes and enhancing organisational effectiveness. It recommends that organisations embed justice principles to minimise burnout and cynicism, and highlights the broader applicability of the findings for private-sector management practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了组织公平（分配、程序和互动公平）在尼日利亚DHL公司的实践情况，及其对员工倦怠和工作场所犬儒主义的综合与相对影响。研究发现组织公平能显著预测倦怠和犬儒主义，其中程序-互动公平最为关键。
AI.research_question: 组织公平（分配、程序和互动公平）如何影响尼日利亚DHL公司员工的倦怠和工作场所犬儒主义？
AI.motivation: 了解组织公平实践对员工负面心理状态的影响，为企业管理实践提供依据，减少员工倦怠和犬儒主义，提升组织效能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织公平理论（分配公平、程序公平、互动公平）、职业倦怠理论（情绪耗竭、去人格化、个人成就感降低）、工作场所犬儒主义理论（认知、情感、行为维度）。
AI.method: 采用分层抽样从六个州选取212名DHL员工，使用标准化问卷测量倦怠和犬儒主义维度，进行描述性和推断性统计分析（回归、相关、t检验、卡方检验）。
AI.findings: 组织公平能强烈预测倦怠（R=0.895）和工作场所犬儒主义（R=0.635）。更高的公平感知与更低的倦怠和犬儒主义水平相关，其中程序-互动公平影响最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了组织公平理论在尼日利亚物流行业的适用性，明确了程序-互动公平对员工负面心理状态的关键作用，拓展了公平-倦怠-犬儒主义关系的实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议企业将公平原则嵌入组织流程和人际互动中，以减少员工倦怠和犬儒主义，提升组织效能，研究结果对私营部门管理实践具有广泛适用性。

detail.abstract: Addiction is commonly framed as dependence on substances or behaviors, yet an equally pervasive form remains under-examined: emotional addiction. Emotional addictions occur when individuals become unconsciously attached to familiar biochemical states-such as anger, victimhood, or self-doubt-because these states once provided safety or predictability. Within the Energy Intelligence Method™, such patterns are recognized as identity-level imprints maintained by neurochemical familiarity rather than conscious choice. This paper introduces a bottom-up model of transformation that begins with shifting the energetic and emotional charge beneath the pattern rather than attempting top-down cognitive control. Two opposing cycles are presented: the Downward Addiction Loop, which sustains emotional dependence, and the Self-Love Cycle, which restores coherence through transmutation of emotional energy. The model is illustrated through client cases, grounded in current psychophysiological research, and integrated with Energy Intelligence Method™ principles. Implications for psychology, education, and trauma-informed coaching are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出情绪成瘾概念，认为个体可能无意识依赖熟悉的情感生化状态（如愤怒、受害者心态），并介绍了一种自下而上的转化模型，通过转变模式下的能量和情感负荷来打破情绪依赖循环。
AI.research_question: 如何有效识别和转化情绪成瘾模式，特别是那些基于神经化学熟悉性而非意识选择维持的身份层面印记？

AI.theoretical_framework: 能量智能方法™框架、神经化学熟悉性理论、心理生理学研究、情绪能量转化理论、向下成瘾循环与自爱循环的对立模型。
AI.method: 自下而上的转化模型（从转变能量和情感负荷开始而非自上而下的认知控制）、客户案例研究、心理生理学研究的理论基础整合。

title: Structural Mechanism Design: Solving Coordination Failures via Temporal Collapse

detail.title: Structural Mechanism Design: Solving Coordination Failures via Temporal Collapse

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that this research was conducted as an independent initiative. No external funding was received, and there are no financial or non-financial competing interests to disclose. The views expressed in this paper are those of the author and do not necessarily reflect the position of Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile

detail.abstract:
Coordination failures are not inevitable; they are artifacts of time. By collapsing commitment and settlement into a single atomic moment, cooperation becomes structurally dominant.

This paper introduces Structural Mechanism Design (SMD), a framework that shifts the objective from incentive compatibility to execution atomicity. We argue that global inefficiencies, from the $1 trillion wasted in supply chains to the fragility of financial systems, are not behavioral flaws but structural defects of sequential execution. By removing the temporal lag between commitment and action, SMD transforms intractable sequential pathologies (Holdout, Free-Rider, Bank Runs) into simultaneous Assurance games.

Crucially, the mechanism we propose is not new. Humans have been coordinating conditionally for millennia, from tribal hunters pooling resources for expeditions, to medieval guilds funding communal tools, to friends organizing group purchases. What is new is the ability to scale this ancient logic to millions of strangers who will never meet.

We present the implementation of this framework via Threshold-Activated Conditional Coordination (TACC) and the Vector Liquidity Protocol (VLP). VLP utilizes a Materialized Aggregate State to achieve constant-time O(1) verification, making atomic coordination viable at macroeconomic scale (n > 100,000).

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构机制设计(SMD)框架，通过将承诺和结算压缩到单一原子时刻，将协调失败转化为结构上占优的合作游戏，实现大规模陌生人之间的协调。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构机制设计解决大规模协调失败问题？具体而言，如何通过消除承诺与行动之间的时间滞后，将难以处理的顺序病理转化为同时保证游戏？
AI.motivation: 全球效率低下（如供应链浪费1万亿美元、金融系统脆弱性）并非行为缺陷，而是顺序执行的结构缺陷。协调失败不是不可避免的，而是时间的产物。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构机制设计(SMD)框架，从激励兼容性转向执行原子性；阈值激活条件协调(TACC)；向量流动性协议(VLP)；物质化聚合状态；保证游戏理论。
AI.method: 提出VLP协议实现SMD框架，利用物质化聚合状态实现恒定时间O(1)验证，使原子协调在宏观经济规模（n>100,000）上可行。
AI.findings: 通过将承诺和结算压缩到单一原子时刻，可以将Holdout、Free-Rider、Bank Runs等顺序病理转化为同时保证游戏，使合作成为结构上占优的策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出结构机制设计(SMD)新框架；2. 将协调失败重新定义为结构而非行为问题；3. 将古代条件协调逻辑扩展到大规模陌生人协调；4. 提出物质化聚合状态实现O(1)验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解决供应链浪费（1万亿美元）问题；2. 增强金融系统稳定性；3. 实现大规模陌生人协调；4. 提供可扩展的协调机制（n>100,000）。

title: Building and Performance Validation of a Digital Twin Regulatory Framework for Financial Compliance and Market Transparency
affiliations: , UBS Business Solutions (China) Limited, University of College London and HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

detail.title: Building and Performance Validation of a Digital Twin Regulatory Framework for Financial Compliance and Market Transparency
detail.abstract: Proposes Reg-Twin-a digitalization of the end-to-end process from transaction → alert → case → SAR/SEC reporting. It incorporates a built-in policy rule engine, reconciliation and drift monitoring, and strategy A/B sandboxing. Through hash-chain data inheritance + selective zero-knowledge proofs (ZK), it demonstrates key compliance points to regulators without data leakage. In simulations and replays across 3,500+ funds and 70+ institutions:-Consistency defects reduced by 41%-Cross-report discrepancies decreased by 36%-Closing cycles shortened by 22%-Estimated alert volume/personnel efficiency/SLA error for strategy changes ≤ ±5% ZK proofs minimize sensitive field disclosure while enabling auditable verification. Reg-Twin demonstrates a technical pathway where enhanced transparency coexists with reduced compliance costs.

AI.tldr: Reg-Twin是一个端到端数字化的合规监管系统，通过内置策略引擎、零知识证明等技术，在提高透明度的同时降低合规成本
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既能提高监管透明度又能降低合规成本的数字化监管系统？
AI.motivation: 传统合规流程存在效率低下、成本高昂、数据泄露风险等问题，需要一种既能满足监管要求又能保护敏感信息的解决方案
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字孪生技术、零知识证明理论、区块链哈希链技术、监管科技理论
AI.method: 模拟和回放实验，涵盖3500+基金和70+机构，使用哈希链数据继承和选择性零知识证明技术
AI.findings: 一致性缺陷减少41%，跨报告差异减少36%，关闭周期缩短22%，策略变更的估计警报量/人员效率/SLA误差≤±5%
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Reg-Twin框架，将数字孪生与零知识证明结合，为监管透明度与数据隐私保护提供了理论解决方案
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可实际部署的监管系统，显著提升合规效率，降低运营成本，为金融机构提供了可行的技术实施路径

title: Per-Country Caps and the Concentration of Intergenerational Harm: A Microsimulation of Age-Out Dynamics in The United States Employment-Based Immigration System

detail.title: Per-Country Caps and the Concentration of Intergenerational Harm: A Microsimulation of Age-Out Dynamics in The United States Employment-Based Immigration System
detail.abstract: The U.S. employment-based (EB) immigration system operates under two binding statutory constraints: a fixed annual limit of 140,000 visas and a 7% per-country cap. Together, these rules generate backlogs exceeding 1.8 million applicants and produce wait times that vary by decades across nationalities. These extended delays carry acute implications for dependent children, who lose eligibility for derivative status at age 21. Although prior research has estimated the backlog's scale and documented its unequal distribution, it has not produced a unified, petitioner-level model capable of capturing the queue's temporal evolution, isolating the specific contribution of the per-country cap, and quantifying child age-out risk under alternative policy regimes. This study addresses these gaps by developing a discrete-event microsimulation of the EB immigration system that reconstructs the queue at the petitioner level. The model integrates EB visa petitions from FY2013-FY2024, assigns dependents using nationality-specific demographic profiles, and simulates visa allocations incorporating per-country ceilings, their statutory exceptions, inter-category spillovers, and familybased spillover provisions. Calibration to the June 2025 USCIS backlog yields close agreement with administrative data, reproducing the total backlog within 1.6% and the India EB-2/EB-3 queues within 0.8%. The model is then projected through FY2035 under two scenarios: the current capped system and an uncapped counterfactual that removes only the per-country limit. Across the projection period, age-outs rise from 3,721 under uncapped allocation to 62,764 under capped allocation, an increase of 59,043. In the capped scenario, Indian children account for 98.8% of all age-outs, compared to 36.1% in the uncapped scenario. The findings provide the first integrated estimate of how per-country limits dynamically magnify and concentrate intergenerational exclusion within the U.S. EB immigration system.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于申请人的离散事件微观模拟模型，分析美国就业移民系统中的国家配额限制如何导致排队时间差异，并量化了子女因超龄而失去移民资格的风险。研究发现，取消国家配额限制可将超龄风险从62,764例减少到3,721例。
AI.research_question: 美国就业移民系统中的国家配额限制如何动态地放大和集中代际排斥？
AI.motivation: 美国就业移民系统存在两个法定约束：每年14万张签证的固定限额和7%的国家配额限制。这些规则导致超过180万申请人的积压，不同国籍的等待时间相差数十年。这些延迟对随行子女有严重影响，他们在21岁时会失去移民资格。现有研究虽然估计了积压规模并记录了不平等分布，但缺乏统一的申请人级别模型来分析排队动态、隔离国家配额的具体影响，以及量化不同政策下的子女超龄风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民政策分析、排队理论、离散事件模拟、代际公平理论
AI.method: 开发了一个离散事件微观模拟模型，重建申请人级别的排队系统。模型整合了2013-2024财年的EB签证申请数据，使用国籍特定的人口统计资料分配家属，并模拟签证分配过程，包括国家配额上限、法定例外、类别间溢出和家庭移民溢出条款。模型校准到2025年6月的USCIS积压数据。
AI.findings: 1. 模型校准结果与行政数据高度一致：总积压误差在1.6%以内，印度EB-2/EB-3队列误差在0.8%以内。2. 在预测期内（到2035财年），有国家配额限制的情况下，子女超龄数量为62,764例；取消国家配额限制后，超龄数量减少到3,721例，减少了59,043例。3. 在有配额限制的情况下，印度子女占所有超龄案例的98.8%；在无配额限制的情况下，这一比例降至36.1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提供了国家配额限制如何动态放大和集中代际排斥的综合估计。2. 开发了第一个能够捕捉排队时间演变、隔离国家配额具体影响的申请人级别模型。3. 为移民政策分析提供了新的微观模拟方法框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 量化了当前移民政策对子女移民资格的实际影响。2. 为政策制定者提供了取消国家配额限制可能带来的具体效益数据。3. 揭示了印度申请人在当前系统下承受的不成比例的超龄风险。4. 为移民政策改革提供了实证依据。

title: Temporal Metaphor as a Method for Exploring the Japanese Linguistic Worldview
affiliations: MGIMO (Moscow State University of International Relations)

detail.title: Temporal Metaphor as a Method for Exploring the Japanese Linguistic Worldview
detail.abstract:
Time is one of the fundamental categories of reality, as no sphere of human activity can be considered outside of time and space. Each language reflects both universal features and the specific cognitive mechanisms for the formation of temporal meanings. In particular, temporal metaphors serve as a source of information about the cognitive processes that influence the formation of a nationally specific worldview shaped by the development of a particular culture.

This paper focuses on the conceptualization of time within the spatial model in Japanese and the specifics of the formation of metaphorical meanings of time expressed by the lexemes 前　後　後ろ　先. Three axes of conceptualization of spatial representations into temporal ones are examined: forward-backward, up-down, and right-left.
The specifics of the metaphorization of time in terms of space demonstrate the complex interaction between linguistic factors and the pragmatic aspects of utterance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了日语中时间概念的空间模型化，特别是通过"前、後、後ろ、先"等词汇表达的时间隐喻意义，探讨了前-后、上-下、左-右三个空间概念轴如何转化为时间概念，揭示了语言因素与语用方面的复杂互动。
AI.research_question: 日语中时间概念如何通过空间模型进行概念化？特别是通过"前、後、後ろ、先"等词汇表达的时间隐喻意义是如何形成的？
AI.motivation: 时间是现实的基本范畴之一，所有人类活动都离不开时间和空间。每种语言既反映普遍特征，也反映形成时间意义的特定认知机制。时间隐喻是了解影响特定文化发展所形成的民族特定世界观认知过程的信息来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间概念的空间隐喻理论；认知语言学中的概念隐喻理论；语言相对论（萨丕尔-沃尔夫假说）关于语言如何塑造思维的观点。
AI.method: 语言分析：对日语中"前、後、後ろ、先"等时间相关词汇的隐喻意义进行语义分析；概念分析：考察前-后、上-下、左-右三个空间概念轴如何转化为时间概念；对比分析：探讨日语时间概念化的民族特性。
AI.findings: 日语中时间概念主要通过空间模型进行隐喻表达；"前、後、後ろ、先"等词汇体现了复杂的时间空间化过程；时间隐喻化展示了语言因素与语用方面的复杂互动；日语的时间概念化反映了日本文化的特定认知机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对日语时间概念空间隐喻的理解；为跨语言时间概念化研究提供了日语案例；丰富了概念隐喻理论在日语中的应用；揭示了语言如何反映特定文化的认知方式。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于日语教学中的时间表达理解；为跨文化交际提供语言认知基础；为翻译实践中的时间概念转换提供指导；为认知语言学研究提供日语实证材料。
